instruction.name: ctz.w
instruction.description: Count trailing zeros in the low 32 bits of rj and write the count to rd.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: ctz.w $r12, $r4; ctz.w $r13, $r5; ctz.w $r14, $r6; ctz.w $r15, $r7; ctz.w $r16, $r8; ctz.w $r17, $r9; ctz.w $r18, $r10; ctz.w $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'ctz.w $r12, $r4; ctz.w $r13, $r5; ctz.w $r14, $r6; ctz.w $r15, $r7; ctz.w $r16, $r8; ctz.w $r17, $r9; ctz.w $r18, $r10; ctz.w $r19, $r11'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
